intent: runtime-split Phase 1: runtime-pin emission — gator_core.write_runtime_pin + update/gatorize wiring + gator-runtime-pin-v1 contract
notes: **Phase 1 of the runtime split (roadmap item 19; Variant A ratified + Phase 0 audit Architect-approved 2026-08-18).** New `gator_core.write_runtime_pin(gator_dir, version=None)` (+ `_read_machine_id_value` best-effort helper) emits `.gator/runtime-pin.json` — the COMMITTED record of which shipped runtime is in force: schema tag, `runtime_version`, `pinned_at` (UTC), `pinned_by_machine` (nullable), and a sha256 manifest of every file under the shipped scripts dir (v2 `.includes/scripts/` first, v1 `scripts/` fallback; `__pycache__` excluded), keyed by posix relpath. Returns None (writes nothing) when no shipped scripts dir exists. Mirrored into the template `gator_core.py` so repo-resident standalone runs behave identically.

**Wiring**: `gator-update.py::main()` (both wheel + template copies; after the `.gator-version` stamp, before `print_result`) and `gatorize.py` v2 install path (after `write_gator_version`) — all inside try/except: pin emission is additive and must never fail an update/install. Reader-free until Phase 2's resolver.

**Contract**: `contracts/schemas/gator-runtime-pin-v1.json` (Draft 2020-12; `additionalProperties: true` per the additive-friendly invariant; digest values pattern-pinned to `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`) + valid/invalid fixtures + `contracts/compatibility/test_runtime_pin.py` (8 tests incl. live-repo conformance; no date-grandfathering — new artifact class).

**Unit pins**: `tests/test_gator_core.py::TestWriteRuntimePin` (6 tests: v2 manifest correctness with byte-exact hash, pycache exclusion, v1 fallback, no-scripts → None, timestamp shape + machine field, idempotent re-emission).

**Dogfooded on this repo**: source `gator-update` run emitted the first live pin — `2.8.0, 20 files` (matches the Phase 0 audit inventory exactly); live contract test flipped from skip to pass. The pin file is committed here as the first instance.

**Design finding recorded** (plan §8 risk 7): manifest hashes on-disk bytes, so `core.autocrlf` makes cross-platform manifest comparison invalid — Phase 2 verification must use git blob hashes or newline normalization. Charter tripwire added.

**Incidental catch → inbox**: `gator update` ships template `__pycache__/*.pyc` into repos (pre-existing `plan_updates` nested-subdir walk quirk; pin manifest unaffected). Small fix queued for a maintenance commit.
Charters: `scripts-core-library.md` (new function entry + 3 tripwires), `scripts-repo-lifecycle.md` (emission wiring invariant), `contracts.md` (schema row + files→functions row).
